[
{"id":"ka0225","verbatim":"The validity of an unpatented mineral claim, in terms of both its location and its maintenance, depends on rigorous compliance with an intricate body of federal and state, statutory and decisional law.","paraphrase":"Whether an unpatented mining claim remains valid, both as to where it sits and as to how it is kept up, turns on rigorous adherence to an intricate framework of federal and state statutes and case law.","different_hard":"The validity of an unpatented mineral claim, in terms of both its location and its maintenance, does not depend on compliance with a complex body of federal and state, statutory and decisional law."},
{"id":"ka0226","verbatim":"Pet food, supply and service companies are intensely competitive and are characterized by a considerable number of competitors ranging from small to large companies with substantial resources.","paraphrase":"The pet food, supply and service sectors are marked by intense rivalry, with many competitors, from small firms up to large firms, holding substantial resources.","different_hard":"Pet food, supply and service companies are not highly competitive and are not characterized by a large number of competitors ranging from small to large companies with substantial resources."},
{"id":"ka0227","verbatim":"We may be required to capitalize a substantial amount of intangibles, including goodwill, which may lead to significant amortization or write-off charges.","paraphrase":"We might have to recognize a meaningful sum of intangible assets, such as goodwill, a development that could produce heavy amortization or write-off charges.","different_hard":"We may be required to capitalize a significant amount of intangibles, including goodwill, which may reduce amortization or write-off charges."},
{"id":"ka0228","verbatim":"This could have a material adverse effect on revenues and materially reduce the Fund’s available capital.","paraphrase":"Such an outcome could materially harm revenues and substantially diminish the capital available to the Trust.","different_hard":"This could have no material adverse effect on revenues and would not materially reduce the Trust’s available capital."},
{"id":"ka0229","verbatim":"In addition, we could issue additional ordinary shares in connection with future strategic partnerships, acquisitions, joint ventures or investments.","paraphrase":"We may also issue further ordinary shares as part of prospective strategic alliances, acquisitions, joint ventures or investments.","different_hard":"In addition, we could repurchase ordinary shares in connection with future strategic alliances, acquisitions, joint ventures or investments."},
{"id":"ka0230","verbatim":"During 2014, the supply of steel was sufficient to support our manufacturing requirements.","paraphrase":"Throughout 2011, steel supply proved enough to meet our manufacturing requirements.","different_hard":"During 2011, the supply of steel was insufficient to support our manufacturing requirements."},
{"id":"ka0231","verbatim":"Lastly, under specific circumstances, the IRS may automatically adjust your personal return without the opportunity for a hearing if it adjusts our tax return.","paraphrase":"Lastly, in particular situations, the Internal Revenue Service may make an automatic change to your individual return, with no hearing available, should it adjust our return.","different_hard":"Finally, under certain circumstances, the IRS may automatically adjust your personal return with the opportunity for a hearing if it adjusts our tax return."},
{"id":"ka0232","verbatim":"However, there can be no assurance that such non-correlation will continue during subsequent periods.","paraphrase":"Still, we cannot guarantee that this lack of correlation will persist in later periods.","different_hard":"However, there can be assurance that such non-correlation will continue during future periods."},
{"id":"ka0233","verbatim":"If the Investment Manager, for any reason, is not able to provide investment opportunities to us consistent with our investment objectives in a timely manner, we may have lower returns on our investments.","paraphrase":"Should the Investment Advisor, for whatever cause, be unable to present us with investment opportunities that match our objectives in good time, our returns on investments could be lower.","different_hard":"If the Investment Advisor, for any reason, is able to provide investment opportunities to us consistent with our investment objectives in a timely manner, we may have higher returns on our investments."},
{"id":"ka0234","verbatim":"the need to establish second sources for the manufacture of Velcora API and tablets;","paraphrase":"the necessity of arranging alternate suppliers for making Korlym API and tablets;","different_hard":"the need to eliminate second sources for the manufacture of Korlym API and tablets;"},
{"id":"ka0235","verbatim":"The business structure of China is, in numerous respects, different from the business culture in Western countries and could present some difficulty for Western investors reviewing contractual relationships among companies in China and evaluating the merits of an investment.","paraphrase":"China's commercial structure differs in many ways from the business culture of Western nations, and this may make it hard for Western investors to examine contracts between Chinese companies and to judge whether an investment is worthwhile.","different_hard":"The business structure of China is, in many respects, similar to the business culture in Western countries and may present no difficulty for Western investors reviewing contractual relationships among companies in China and evaluating the merits of an investment."},
{"id":"ka0236","verbatim":"Congress has also proposed several legislative initiatives, including potential repeal of PPACA.","paraphrase":"Lawmakers in Congress have additionally put forward various legislative measures, among them a possible repeal of PPACA.","different_hard":"Congress has also enacted a number of legislative initiatives, including repeal of PPACA."},
{"id":"ka0237","verbatim":"If we do not effectively implement our business strategy, we may be unable to generate cash needed to make distributions to our stockholders and to maintain or increase the value of our assets.","paraphrase":"Should our business strategy not be carried out successfully, we might fail to produce the cash required to pay distributions to our stockholders and to keep up or raise the worth of our assets.","different_hard":"If we successfully implement our business strategy, we may be unable to generate cash needed to make distributions to our stockholders and to maintain or increase the value of our assets."},
{"id":"ka0238","verbatim":"These in-house design groups may develop products that compete with ours.","paraphrase":"Those in-house design teams could create products in competition with ours.","different_hard":"These internal design groups may not develop products that compete with ours."},
{"id":"ka0239","verbatim":"We currently have 16,204,517 shares of Common Stock outstanding which could be diluted by the following potential issuances of Common Stock.","paraphrase":"Our outstanding Common Stock currently totals 15,809,023 shares, and that amount could be diluted by the potential future issuances of Common Stock listed below.","different_hard":"We currently have 15,809,023 shares of Common Stock outstanding which could not be diluted by the following potential issuances of Common Stock."},
{"id":"ka0240","verbatim":"A significant portion of our revenue comes from managing U.S. mutual funds.","paraphrase":"A large share of our revenues is derived from the management of U.S. mutual funds.","different_hard":"A small portion of our revenue comes from managing U.S. mutual funds."},
{"id":"ka0241","verbatim":"Additionally, state and/or federal regulations require mandatory conservation measures, which would reduce the demand for energy.","paraphrase":"Also, regulations at the state and/or federal level compel conservation measures that are mandatory, and these would cut the demand for energy.","different_hard":"In addition, state and/or federal regulations require mandatory conservation measures, which would increase the demand for energy."},
{"id":"ka0242","verbatim":"sell some assets or merge with or into other companies.","paraphrase":"dispose of specific holdings or combine with other businesses through merger.","different_hard":"acquire certain assets or merge with or into other companies."},
{"id":"ka0243","verbatim":"The Company has been adversely impacted in the past, and could be adversely impacted in the future, when customers experience disruptions resulting from tighter capital and credit markets, changes in reimbursement, or a loss of patient revenue due to changes in the general economy.","paraphrase":"In the past, the Company has suffered harm, and it could suffer again, whenever customers are disrupted by tighter capital and credit conditions, shifts in reimbursement, or lost patient revenue arising from broader economic changes.","different_hard":"The Company has been positively impacted in the past, and could be positively impacted in the future, when customers experience disruptions resulting from tighter capital and credit markets, changes in reimbursement, or a loss of patient revenue due to changes in the general economy."},
{"id":"ka0244","verbatim":"The $250,000 that we contributed to PDS in December 2012 and the $150,000 that we and TPL each contributed in each of March 2013, April 2013 and May 2013 was used to pay the first, fourth, fifth and sixth installments of the retainer.","paraphrase":"Installments one, four, five and six of the retainer were funded by the $200,000 we paid PDS in December 2011 and by the $150,000 that each of us and TPL put in during each of March, April and May 2012.","different_hard":"The $200,000 that we contributed to PDS in December 2011 and the $150,000 that we and TPL each contributed in each of March 2012, April 2012 and May 2012 was used to pay the second, third, seventh and eighth installments of the retainer."},
{"id":"ka0245","verbatim":"Our short term business success is heavily dependent upon our United States and Canadian licensing and research and development agreements which have been assigned to Belmont.","paraphrase":"Our near-term commercial success depends heavily on our licensing and research and development agreements covering the United States and Canada, which were transferred to Almont.","different_hard":"Our short term business success is not highly dependent upon our United States and Canadian licensing and research and development agreements which have been assigned to Almont."},
{"id":"ka0246","verbatim":"We require significant capital expenditures to conduct our operations, engage in acquisition activities and replace our production, and we may be unable to obtain financing on acceptable terms necessary to execute our operating strategy.","paraphrase":"Running our operations, pursuing acquisitions and replacing our output all demand large amounts of capital spending, and we might not be able to secure financing on acceptable terms needed to carry out our operating strategy.","different_hard":"We require minimal capital expenditures to conduct our operations, engage in acquisition activities and replace our production, and we may be unable to obtain financing on satisfactory terms necessary to execute our operating strategy."},
{"id":"ka0247","verbatim":"Failure to generate adequate cash to service our indebtedness could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.","paraphrase":"If we cannot produce enough cash to meet our debt payments, our business, financial position and operating results could suffer.","different_hard":"Success in generating sufficient cash to service our indebtedness could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations."},
{"id":"ka0248","verbatim":"We are also at times involved in litigation relating to alleged infringement by us of others’ patents or other intellectual property rights.","paraphrase":"Occasionally, we also become parties to lawsuits over claims that we have infringed patents or other intellectual property rights belonging to third parties.","different_hard":"We are also from time to time involved in litigation relating to alleged infringement by others of our patents or other intellectual property rights."},
{"id":"ka0249","verbatim":"High Energy Costs - Greater energy costs worldwide and disrupted power supplies may have a material adverse effect on operations.","paraphrase":"Operations could be materially and adversely affected by elevated energy prices across the world, as well as by interruptions in power provision.","different_hard":"High Energy Costs - Higher energy costs worldwide and interrupted power supplies may have a material positive effect on operations."}
]
